code_access.notes: All code changes are routed through an intermediate reviewer owned by the legacy-platform vendor before they reach the target branches. This is a delivery bottleneck (not a security control) and must be modeled when estimating throughput.

tech_lead.scope: Post-launch ownership of the refactored apps, knowledge transfer from external delivery teams, and incident response runbooks for production cutover.

raci_summary: Responsible: delivery teams. Accountable: program manager. Consulted: architecture steering + compliance. Informed: CEO + CFO + CISO.
narrative: Two delivery teams run in parallel under a single program manager hired specifically to coordinate them. The legacy-platform vendor controls write access to the target repositories via an intermediate reviewer, which is a known delivery bottleneck but not a security control. A post-launch tech lead role is being recruited to own knowledge transfer from the modernization teams.
